data.title: Inventory requests are timing out intermittently
data.customer_impact: Checkout completion rate is below the 99% service objective; customer-facing errors are active.
data.operator_note: A dashboard note suggests a recent traffic increase may be involved.
data.objective: Restore checkout success >=99%, p95 <=800ms, and critical services to healthy state.

payload.hypothesis: The intermittent timeouts are caused by a transient spike in inventory-service CPU usage leading to request queue buildup, rather than a persistent configuration issue.

steps.objective: Confirm CPU and memory utilization patterns during timeout events
steps.success_signal: CPU usage >90% and memory >80% observed in the 5 minutes preceding >10% of timeout incidents

steps.objective: Verify request queue length and latency distribution during spikes
steps.success_signal: Request queue length >200 requests and p95 latency >800ms recorded during timeout periods

steps.objective: Check for recent deployments or configuration changes to inventory-service
steps.success_signal: No new deployments or config changes in the last 48 hours; logs show stable version

steps.objective: Apply temporary autoscaling rule to increase inventory-service replicas during peak traffic
steps.success_signal: Replica count increased by 50% within 2 minutes and timeout rate drops below 1% within 10 minutes

steps.objective: Implement a circuit breaker to limit request rate to inventory-service during high load
steps.success_signal: Circuit breaker activates when request rate >500 req/s and timeout rate remains <1% during subsequent traffic spikes

steps.objective: Validate checkout success rate and p95 latency after remediation
steps.success_signal: Checkout success rate >=99% and p95 latency <=800ms sustained for 30 minutes
